name: apple
description: Choose the Apple apps to connect and ask Codex about their data on your Mac.

interface.longDescription: Connect Mail, Notes, Messages, Contacts, Calendar, Reminders and Safari. Choose apps and accounts, folders, mailboxes, chats, calendars, lists or Safari profiles during setup. Apple imports the selected content into a private local copy while you use it and reports when it last synced. macOS controls access to your apps. Requires the ChatGPT desktop app on a Mac.
